settings.load_failed: Could not read the settings. Check the connection.
settings.weekly_goal_hint: Sessions per week, Monday to Sunday. It is the measure of consistency.
settings.weight_note: The same weight in Health and Nutrition. With it, pull-ups and dips count for strength.
start.hint: {detail} The session clock starts when you confirm.
start.title: Start {name}?
stats.bodyweight_load: the load is your weight plus the added load
stats.colours: Green, gaining strength; red, losing; grey, steady or no data. Tap a muscle to see it.
stats.detected: Detected: the level jumped {jump} and stayed there.
stats.empty_hint: As soon as you finish a workout, this screen starts counting.
stats.grey_unreliable: In grey, estimates above ten reps: unreliable.
stats.gyms_differ: Each gym is another machine: their kilos are not compared with each other.
stats.index_missing: Some muscle needs sessions in at least two weeks of the period. With a wider period, or a few more weeks, it shows up.
stats.index_note.one: Base 100 at the start of the period · average of {count} muscle group, each one comparing each machine with itself
stats.index_note.other: Base 100 at the start of the period · average of {count} muscle groups, each one comparing each machine with itself
stats.it_is_right: It is right: let it count
stats.lines_are_changes: the lines are changes of gym or machine
stats.load_failed_hint: Check the connection and open the tab again.

stats.movers: What goes up and what goes down

stats.no_counted_session: No session counts for strength with this variant yet.
stats.no_primary: No exercise has it as its primary muscle.
stats.not_enough: Not enough sessions in this period to say whether its strength goes up or down.
stats.open_session: Open the session to correct it

stats.per_muscle: For each muscle, the strength and the sets per week, with the 10 to 20 range.
stats.set_aside.one: {count} day set aside for not fitting
stats.set_aside.other: {count} days set aside for not fitting
stats.strength_by_muscle: Strength by muscle in the period
stats.why.above: {gap} % above the surrounding sessions on this machine {reference}
stats.why.below: {gap} % below the surrounding sessions on this machine {reference}
stats.why.counted: It counts because you said so
stats.you_marked: You marked it. Before and after are not compared.
stats.you_said_same: You said it did not change, even though the level jumped.
